crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to Moses, “Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: that I will utterly…
“Isn’t this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?
You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?
Then those who feared Yahweh spoke one with another; and Yahweh listened, and heard, and a book of memory was written…
I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened…
“I have been silent a long time. I have been quiet and restrained myself. Now I will cry out like a travailing woman. I…
Will you hold yourself back for these things, Yahweh? Will you keep silent and punish us very severely?
Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.
You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you…
Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.
First I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double, because they have polluted my land with the carcasses of…
But as for them whose heart walks after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their…
Therefore I have poured out my indignation on them. I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath. I have brought…
“Yes, and what are you to me, Tyre, and Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Will you repay me? And if you repay…

translations.web: “Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will repay, yes, I will repay into their bosom,
translations.bsb: Behold, it is written before Me: I will not keep silent, but I will repay; I will pay it back into their laps,
translations.kjv: Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,
translations.asv: Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, yea, I will recompense into their bosom,
